summary: Jullien's golden carp is a large river carp native to Peninsular Malaysia. Habitat change and heavy harvest have reduced wild populations; Malaysian programmes also breed and release it for conservation and fisheries.
nativeRange: Southeast Asia, including river basins in Malaysia, Thailand, Laos, Cambodia and Vietnam.

features: Several dark lengthwise stripes on the flanks

habitat.description: Large lowland river basins, including the Pahang and Perak systems; Kenyir populations were stocked.
habitat.diet: Mixed diet including aquatic plants, invertebrates and fruit.

malaysia.rules: Listed in CITES Appendix I. International trade is tightly controlled; this does not by itself establish local fishing permission. Rules change and differ by state — check with your state Fisheries Office. Checked 13 October 2026.

eating: A valuable freshwater food fish; wild populations require conservation.
